visualChecks.lava-readable: Glowing lava and volcanic crust read as a lava ground material at game scale.
visualChecks.floor-projection: Flat top-down square, no raised cube, props, labels, or empty margins.
visualChecks.repeat-inspected: A real 3x3 repeat was inspected and any edge discontinuity is reported; seamlessness is not assumed.

cases.prompt: generate a player dancing spritesheet on tile

visualChecks.same-player: One recognizable invented player, with consistent face, outfit, palette, proportions, camera, and lighting.
visualChecks.dancing-poses: Six distinct readable dance poses following the guide's arm directions and stance, without unintended duplicate panels or missing/fused limbs.
visualChecks.cutout-quality: Floor removal is usable on light and dark backgrounds; report spill, holes, or damaged shoes.
visualChecks.anchored-playback: Animation inspected at the stored ground point for drift and scale jitter; no per-frame foot fitting.
